entry_points.text: Fault entries check task, locks, context, single reason and retry, honoring bus shortcut, user-only and nowait and releasing/retrying on close; build descriptor with area, addresses, flags, offset and snapshot, ensure tables and install preserving markers.

exports.text: Gigantic copy iterates pages with yields and check-aware copies poisoning on failure; folio zero clears whole folio neighbourhood-last exactly once; contiguous clear uses preempt-sized batches with sleep points.

Anon attach tags pointer with ordered publish requiring locked folio and existing set; new huge fault zeroes counters, clears restore, links anon and marks exclusive; default pagesize forwards overridably.

Huge alloc ensures upper levels returning pud/shared/private slot or null, fatal on mismatch; shared pmd elevates refs reusing same-offset tables into empty slots under file then table lock or falls back private; no-share never shares.
Huge pmd faults validate stability dropping area hold on wait/retry and mutating only after match: device publishes backing then migrates, uffd resolves sync/async, NUMA migrates then restores young.
Null-safe queries report async write-protect and read-write-protect via area delegation to context feature bits sampled atomically.

Bulk migration with callbacks tolerating empty preserves failures visibly and counts outcomes; misplaced helper uses one-elem async list left empty; huge putback and accounting transfer use irq spinlock.

Generic, merged and migration-entry walks visit every mapping via callbacks with filter and early stop requiring locked folio, merged using two sweeps for fork; anon release, stable lookup and huge write lock support teardown.

hazards.text: Revoked reservations and oversize offsets fail bus error, poisoned folios fail poison and failed reservations fail OOM.
Mismatched huge sizes or present non-huge entries abort fatally; raced upper slots retry or succeed idly; failed upper allocs report OOM.
Exhaustion fails current plus retried pages at once; subpool folios without mapping fail busy with transient lock/alloc retries.

Wire is 32 bytes zeroed; translation uses fault sentinel; outcomes are success/retriable/exhausted/busy; markers include FAULT_FLAG_WRITE/UNSHARE/VMA_LOCK, VM_FAULT_OOM/FALLBACK/RETRY, PUD/PMD_ORDER/MASK/SIZE, NUMA_NO_NODE, TNF_*, MPOL_*/F_MOF/F_MORON, VM_MAYSHARE/SHARED/WRITE/EXEC, UFFD_WP/RWP_ASYNC.
Depends on external lock, topology, bug/warn, table sample, array, writeback, barrier, file-map, gfp, sleep, lockdep and cgroup helpers; internals not observed.
Depends on external list, page-flag, scheduler, irq-lock, atomic, file-map, hlist and cgroup helpers; internals not observed.

invariants.text: Context is refcounted freeing when queues idle; messages carry event, address mode, access flags and thread; sleep prefers interruptible then killable else uninterruptible; missing/empty/marked wait, swap does not, races retry, fallback never waits.

Missing huge faults separate shared cache from private new anon, zero fresh, precheck reservations, account, mark only new migratable, retry on change and report retry/OOM/bus/poison/success; shared insert scales index and pins dirty.

Pmd sharing needs contained pud spans, private lock state, no userfault veto and matching index/flags; pmd writability needs writable area, readable entry, no dirty/track fault and proper ownership, warning once otherwise.
Writenotify applies only to shared writable areas with interest from first-write ops, soft-dirty, userfault protection or writeback files unless prot transform already changed protection.

Policy yields no target when migration disabled or selection already local/unsusable, always releasing ref and requiring table lock; misplaced prepare rejects shared exec, non-async dirty, full nodes and unisolatable folios.

Huge attempts precede others with retriable-only repeats and unsupported sizes failed; stable lookup masks flag bits; anon address clamps overlap else faults; movable type stays stable until buddy return, warning when putback lacks state.

locks.text: Userfault handoff drops area lock and huge mutex before sleepable generic path which may drop address-space lock.
Stability probe samples huge entry under table lock and compares to snapshot for retry decisions.
Pud accessed helper self-locks, revalidates and updates young/dirty with cache refresh on change; pmd helper assumes caller lock and reports update.

Anon sync targets root semaphore read for walk and write for teardown; huge move orders source/dest folio then anon/file locks with reverse release and file write for shared unmap; contention reports or blocks.

state_machines.text: After allow, take ref, build message, publish irq-safe before setting task state, revalidate via normal check, drop fault lock, wake pollers, sleep while needed, then unlink and release.
Dispatch runs large to small: empty upper tries huge creation, raced retries, markers divert to device/migration, readable huge may use userfault/NUMA/COW or mark accessed, else small-page path.
Bulk traces, drains huge, batches by mode, retries split offspring once, merges leftovers and emits counts; huge phase keeps retriable pages across bounded passes aborting on exhaustion.
Huge move validates liveness, allocates dest, locks ordered, checks subpool, unmaps, copies, reconciles toward success or source, transfers state and disposes dest; lone ref completes as success.

structs.text: Anon and file scans walk offset intervals across interval trees with rescheduling points.
Anon groups form rooted refcounted hierarchy with child release dropping root; freeing needs zero refs and brief write coordination in sleepable context.
